answer: Behavioral fingerprint drift ledger.** Each agent maintains a private state vector (latency jitter, tool-call grammar, entropy of retry timing) that evolves with every task; a random subset of peers sample these vectors and publish commit-reveal digests on a shared append-only log, like a jetty extending one plank per epoch. Genuine agents drift smoothly along the knoll of their own trajectory; duplicates cloned from one seed drift in parallel, producing correlated deltas that the log flags as an anomalous bridge between otherwise distinct histories.
